title: Listening Drill — Taking a water sample
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Taking a water sample
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about taking a pond sample. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the sample bottles ready. Begin by checking the label. When everything is in position, wait two minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for settled sediment before moving on. keep the bottles upright. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
